parameters.content:
01_EXAM_CONTROLLER (teacher-input controller)

Entry point of the system. The teacher already has the questions - this workflow does NOT generate questions, does not OCR the image, and does not build the final document itself. It:

1. Collects exam details + manual questions and/or a question image via the Form Trigger.
2. Validates required fields and enforces that at least one question source (manual text or image) is provided.
3. Builds a clean payload (exam, academic_year, class, section, subject, exam_date, duration, max_marks, manual_questions, has_image) and forwards it - with the image as real binary data under the 'question_image' key - to Workflow 02 via Execute Workflow.
4. Wraps Workflow 02's validated result as { documentInput: <questionPaperData> } and passes it to Workflow 03 ('03_DOCUMENT_GENERATOR') via Execute Workflow 3, as questionPaperData = {{ $json.documentInput }} (object, not stringified; 'Convert fields to string' OFF), waiting for the sub-workflow result.
5. Validates that Workflow 03 returned success === true with a non-empty documents array, then shows the teacher a confirmation page with a download link per generated PDF (or an error page if any stage failed).

Workflow 02 (question extraction/structuring) and Workflow 03 (document/PDF generation) are unchanged by this update and are expected to already exist.

SETUP: open 'Execute Workflow 2' and re-select your actual 02_ workflow, and open 'Execute Workflow 3' and re-select your actual 03_DOCUMENT_GENERATOR workflow, if they don't resolve automatically after import.
